en.title: Tom Hiddleston Trekked to Everest and Kevin Feige's Loki Promise
en.summary: Tom Hiddleston shares a fascinating anecdote about his early days as Loki and an inspiring journey to Everest for the film 'Tenzing'. The actor reveals a pivotal conversation with Marvel's Kevin Feige that hinted at Loki's enduring presence in the MCU.
en.body:
The path to becoming an enduring cinematic icon is often paved with unexpected journeys and prescient words. For **Tom Hiddleston**, that path included a literal trek towards Mount Everest and a conversation with Marvel Studios head **Kevin Feige** that would shape his career.

Speaking at the Zurich Film Festival, where he was honored with a Golden Eye Award, Hiddleston recounted his experience preparing for the biographical drama **'Tenzing'**. The film chronicles the historic first ascent of Mount Everest by **Tenzing Norgay** and **Sir Edmund Hillary**. Hiddleston, who plays Hillary, undertook a rigorous journey to the Everest Base Camp. This demanding physical preparation offered him a profound connection to the spirit of exploration and the immense challenge faced by the mountaineers. The film, also starring **Genden Phuntsok** as Tenzing Norgay and **Willem Dafoe**, aims to shed light on the man often overshadowed by his famous partner, highlighting Tenzing's crucial role in the monumental achievement.

It was during these formative years of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, shortly after the release of 2011's **'Thor'**, that Hiddleston received a crucial piece of insight from **Kevin Feige**. "He told me that Thor wasn't going to be the only film he would play Loki in," Hiddleston recalled. This early reassurance from Feige was pivotal, especially given the character's initial portrayal as a villain. It hinted at a deeper, more complex arc for the God of Mischief, one that would allow him to evolve and captivate audiences across multiple films and a Disney+ series, becoming one of the MCU's most beloved and multifaceted characters.

## The Weight of History and a Villain's Future

This dual focus—on the raw, human endeavor of climbing the world's highest peak and the strategic, long-term vision for a burgeoning superhero franchise—underscores Hiddleston's diverse acting interests. While **'Tenzing'** demands a grounded, historical performance, his tenure as Loki has showcased his remarkable range, from Shakespearean villainy to complex anti-heroics. The anticipation for **'Tenzing'** has been building, with its premiere set for the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival, promising a powerful cinematic tribute to a defining moment in human history. The film is slated for a theatrical release on October 9th and will be available for streaming on Apple TV+ on October 16th.

## What's Next

Fans eager to see **Tom Hiddleston** step into the boots of **Sir Edmund Hillary** will have their chance when **'Tenzing'** premieres. Hiddleston has also confirmed he has not yet begun filming **'Avengers: Doomsday'**, though his presence in future MCU installments remains a possibility, fueled by **Kevin Feige**'s early confidence in Loki's lasting appeal.
